note: Generated drafts of the operators' carried items for the PRIM3 level builder, made from the owner's loadout photos (Normal, PBR, 40,000 faces). Textures re-encoded to 1024/512 px JPEG and the generator's doubled specular removed; geometry unchanged. Not wired into the game. Paths are relative to this folder.

E13-compact-carbine.prompt: PRIM3 Field E item 13: compact carbine with its sling, realistic black equipment, no marks.
E13-compact-carbine.review: Black short carbine with collapsible stock, red-dot sight and sling matches the photo; front sling swivel fused into a lump that reads like a vertical grip under the handguard; no text or marks.

R17-scoped-overwatch-rifle.prompt: PRIM3 Field R item 17: scoped overwatch rifle, realistic black equipment, no marks.
R17-scoped-overwatch-rifle.review: Bolt-action rifle with scope, adjustable cheek rest, magazine and vented fore-end closely matches the photo; very dark albedo; no text or marks.

T-field-cyberdeck.prompt: PRIM3 Field T: rugged clamshell field cyberdeck, open, realistic, no marks.
T-field-cyberdeck.review: Rugged open clamshell with bumpered corners, keyboard, trackpad and red side latches matches the photo; screen carries an abstract UI (bars and a line graph, no legible text); keycaps blank.
